--- title: "Getting started with R and RStudio" engine: knitr --- ## Using R via Command Line and Scripts ## 1. Accessing the R console Open a terminal (Command Prompt on Windows, Terminal on Mac/Linux) and type: ::: {.cell} ```{.bash .cell-code} R ``` ::: This launches the R console, where you can type and execute R commands interactively. ::: {#fig-r-terminal} ![](./images/r_terminal.png) R console in a terminal. ::: ## 2. Creating an R Script Open your preferred text editor (e.g. [VS Code for mac](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/?dv=osx), Notepad, [Notepad++ for Windows](https://notepad-plus-plus.org/downloads/), Rstudio). Write your R code and save file with a .R extension. ## 3. Executing the R script in the Terminal Navigate to the directory where your script is saved: ::: {.cell} ```{.bash .cell-code} cd path/to/your/folder ``` ::: Replace `path/to/your/folder` with the actual path where your script.R is saved. - On Windows, paths might look like `C:\Users\YourName\Documents\Rscripts` - On Mac/Linux, paths might look like `/Users/YourName/Documents/Rscripts` ::: {.cell} ```{.bash .cell-code} Rscript script.R ``` ::: ## 4. Using R with Rgui Rgui is a program that is installed alongside R when you install it. It is the standard R user interface. But nobody uses it... ::: {#fig-r-rgui} ![](./images/r_gui.png) R GUI on macOS. ::: ## Using R with RStudio - Our focus in this course RStudio is an integrated development environment (IDE) designed primarily for running R code. It adds many more features and tools to R that allow us to create, e.g.: - reproducible data analyses (via Rmarkdown/Quarto); - interactive dashboarding tools (via RShiny). It is now possible to run Python code, C++ code, SQL queries, ... directly from RStudio. ::: {#fig-r-rstudio} ![](./images/rstudio.png) RStudio interface. ::: ### Console ::: {#fig-r-rstudio-console} ![](./images/rstudio_console.png) RStudio console. ::: ### Script ::: {#fig-r-rstudio-script} ![](./images/rstudio_script.png) RStudio script. ::: ### Environment ::: {#fig-r-rstudio-environment} ![](./images/rstudio_env.png) RStudio environment. ::: ### Packages ::: {#fig-r-rstudio-packages} ![](./images/rstudio_packages.png) RStudio packages. ::: ### Files ::: {#fig-r-rstudio-files} ![](./images/rstudio_files.png) RStudio files. ::: ### Shortcuts Some useful keyboard shortcuts: - Run current line/selection: Ctrl + Enter (⌘ + ⏎) - Insert assignment operator: Alt + − (⎇ + −) - Insert pipe operator: Ctrl + Shift + M (⌘ + ⇧ + M) To see all the shortcuts and modify them:
Tools -\> Modify Keyboard Shortcuts...
